examples.source:
# Exclusive prefix popcount of an 8-bit mask, as x86-64.
#
# The two instructions deposit the mask bits into byte lanes and multiply them
# into exclusive prefix counts.
    # qm-input-bits: 8
    .text
    .globl ranks8_qm
    .type ranks8_qm, @function
ranks8_qm:
    movabsq $0x101010101010101, %r11
    pdep %r11, %rdi, %rdi
    movabsq $0x101010101010100, %r11
    imulq %r11, %rdi
    movq %rdi, %rax
    ret
    .size ranks8_qm, .-ranks8_qm
    .section .note.GNU-stack,"",@progbits

;; Inclusive prefix XOR of 64 bits, as wasm32.
;;
;; wasm has no carry-less multiply, so the scan is six shift/XOR doublings.
;; qm-input-bits: 64
(module
  (func $prefix_xor64_qm (export "prefix_xor64_qm") (param i64) (result i64)
    (local i64 i64 i64 i64 i64 i64)
    local.get 0
    local.get 0
    i64.const 0x1
    i64.shl
    i64.xor
    local.set 1
    local.get 1
    local.get 1
    i64.const 0x2
    i64.shl
    i64.xor
    local.set 2
    local.get 2
    local.get 2
    i64.const 0x4
    i64.shl
    i64.xor
    local.set 3
